answer: On a weighted attestation graph, trust propagates through a bounded-length random walk, and the probability mass crossing a cut is controlled by its conductance. A Sybil cluster behind a sparse external cut therefore receives only limited leakage; min-cut transitivity extends this bound to unions of colluding clusters. Thus, whether identities are labeled jetty, willow, or whisper, their aggregate voting weight scales with boundary conductance, roughly O(tΦ), rather than with their population.
